04 / GET STARTED

Three little steps.

For Android phones and tablets. APKs won’t install on iPhone or iPad.

  1. 01

    Pick your app.

    Read the setup notes. Tap Download APK to save the file.

  2. 02

    Open the download.

    Open the file from Downloads. If asked, allow installation from your browser or Files.

  3. 03

    Install & enjoy.

    Tap Install, then Open. Turn off the source permission afterwards.

Need a hand?

Android won’t install the APK +

Check the app’s minimum Android version and available storage. Re-download if the file is incomplete. Work or school devices, Advanced Protection, and local developer-verification rules may restrict installation. Keep Play Protect enabled and follow the guidance shown on your device. Read Android’s installation guide.

I already have an older test build +

A compatible build normally installs as an update. A different signing certificate may prevent that. Back up or export your data before removing an app: uninstalling can erase local food logs, files and settings.

Can I use these apps on iPhone? +

These downloads are Android APKs. No iPhone, iPad or App Store release is available here yet. You can browse this website on any device.
